about: Every sound, music piece, voice and line generated with ElevenLabs (docs/SOUND_PLAN.md). tools/audio/generate.mjs makes the missing or changed ones into art/source/audio/ (local); tools/audio/review.mjs builds the listening page. Phase 1 (pilot): 6 effects, the opening theme, Miłka's and Czupur's voices in Polish and English with 3 lines each.
palette: Warm, round, playful children's cartoon sound, no harsh highs, nothing scary.

effects.label: Stuknięcie przycisku
effects.prompt: A single soft wooden 'tok' of a small hollow log tapped with a felt mallet, a cartoon button click for a children's game, short and dry.

effects.label: Krok Giganto w otwarciu
effects.prompt: One deep, friendly footstep of a cartoon giant dinosaur: a soft heavy thump on jungle ground with a gentle low rumble and a few leaves shaking. Playful, no roar.

effects.label: Przyjaciel wyskakuje z krzaka
effects.event: a friend pops out of a bush
effects.prompt: A little cartoon dinosaur pops up out of a leafy bush: a quick leaf rustle into a bubbly cartoon 'pop'. Cheerful.

effects.label: Labirynt rozwiązany
effects.prompt: A short cheerful success jingle for a children's maze game: a quick marimba and kalimba run up, a little slide whistle, ending on a giggly cartoon 'boing'. Bright and warm.

effects.label: Znaleziony kokos (dźwięk skarbu)
effects.prompt: A cartoon coconut is found: a hollow wooden 'donk' of a coconut, a short bouncy roll, and a tiny marimba sparkle at the end.

effects.label: Przylatuje motylek z podpowiedzią
effects.prompt: A cartoon butterfly flutters in: soft papery wing flutters with a tiny glassy chime. Gentle and a little magical.

music.event: the full opening (7.5 s: curtains, two footsteps, Giganto peeks, friends pop up, the sign drops, 'Graj' sprouts)

styles: two soft low tuba notes like friendly giant footsteps
ends on a happy little flourish

voices.name: Dino Mazes · Miłka (PL)
voices.description: An adult female voice actress performing a small, playful triceratops character in a Polish children's cartoon. Native Polish speaker, standard Polish accent. Bright, bubbly and quick, cheeky and warm, with a smile in every word; she lands a joke with a tiny pause and a giggle. Clean studio recording, close microphone.
voices.text: Cześć, jestem Miłka! Chcesz usłyszeć dowcip? Jak nazywa się śpiący dinozaur? Chrapozaur! Hi, hi! Wyglądam na małą, a jestem najsilniejsza z nas!

voices.name: Dino Mazes · Tiny (EN)
voices.description: An adult female voice actress performing a small, playful triceratops character in an English children's cartoon. Native British English speaker. Bright, bubbly and quick, cheeky and warm, with a smile in every word; she lands a joke with a tiny pause and a giggle. Clean studio recording, close microphone.
voices.text: Hi, I'm Tiny! Want to hear a joke? What do you call a sleeping dinosaur? A dino-snore! Hee hee! I may be Tiny, but I'm the strongest of us all!

voices.name: Dino Mazes · Czupur (PL)
voices.description: An adult male voice actor performing an energetic young parasaurolophus character in a Polish children's cartoon. Native Polish speaker, standard Polish accent. Bold, fast and excitable, slightly raspy, always in a hurry, with loud happy shouts; a proud little show-off, but warm and friendly. Clean studio recording, close microphone.
voices.text: Cześć, jestem Czupur! Najszybszy dinozaur w dżungli! Mam trąbkę na głowie. Tuuu, tuuu! Kiedyś przybiję piątkę z Giganto. Zobaczysz!

voices.name: Dino Mazes · Rocky (EN)
voices.description: An adult male voice actor performing an energetic young parasaurolophus character in an English children's cartoon. Native British English speaker. Bold, fast and excitable, slightly raspy, always in a hurry, with loud happy shouts; a proud little show-off, but warm and friendly. Clean studio recording, close microphone.
voices.text: Hi, I'm Rocky! The fastest dino in the jungle! I've got a trumpet on my head. Toot, toot! One day I'll high-five Giganto. You'll see!
